recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-14073 unless OO opens a new issue to change obs-7 semantics beyond the currently confirmed coding-intersection rule.
issue_request: FHIR-14073 asked to fix the Observation obs-7 FHIRPath expression by replacing value.empty() or code!=component.code with a code/system comparison between Observation.component.code.coding and Observation.code.coding.
initial_application: Git commit 311839957674a44444b3876d8e7a24662b624742 applied the request to the old Observation spreadsheet. Later FHIRPath cleanup commit 45ea9aefcb917dfc0bd4264c32b39aaa73f43309 rewrote the expression to the current coding.intersect(%resource.code.coding) form, which was carried into the active StructureDefinition after source refactoring.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-20319 later reassessed the same expression family and was resolved No Change because the current invariant meets the requirement. The linked Zulip Profile Validation thread explains the original problem with CodeableConcept equality and supports comparing codings rather than whole CodeableConcept objects. FHIR-14019, FHIR-38955, and FHIR-20521 are related obs-7 wording/metadata issues already represented separately on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source was changed. The active Observation StructureDefinition already uses value.empty() or component.code.where(coding.intersect(%resource.code.coding).exists()).empty(), and reverting to the literal 2017 expression would undo later confirmed FHIRPath cleanup.
